description: This PHP source file defines the 'ApiAuthorizationSubscriber' class, which is an event subscriber in the OrangeHRM system responsible for handling API authorization. It listens for controller and exception events to enforce permissions based on user roles and API routes, and manages HTTP responses for unauthorized access attempts.

classes.name: ApiAuthorizationSubscriber
classes.description: An event subscriber class responsible for managing API authorization. It subscribes to kernel controller and exception events to enforce access permissions and handles forbidden exceptions by returning appropriate HTTP responses.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Defines the events this subscriber listens to, specifically controller and exception events, with associated handler methods and priorities.

methods.name: onControllerEvent
methods.description: Handles controller events, checks if the controller is an instance of certain interfaces, retrieves API permissions, and throws ForbiddenException if access is unauthorized.

methods.name: onExceptionEvent
methods.description: Handles exception events, specifically ForbiddenException, and generates a JSON error response with 403 status code.

methods.name: getControllerInstance
methods.description: Private helper method to extract the controller instance from the event.

methods.name: getPermissionGetterMethod
methods.description: Maps HTTP methods to permission getter method names ('canRead', 'canCreate', etc.)
